items.name: Letter Visitors
items.tagline: See website visitors on your website itself
items.description: Know who’s on your website: the people, their companies, and the AI agents reading your pages. See them on your own site, and replay their sessions.

items.name: Gauth Personal Study Agent
items.tagline: An AI study agent that remembers where you struggle
items.description: Gauth Personal Study Agent connects the questions you snap, the quizzes you take, and the topics you study into one ongoing picture of how you learn. Instead of starting from scratch each session, it spots the gap behind a mistake, builds a short daily plan around it, and adjusts that plan when you miss a review or master a topic early. Practice comes as flashcards, guided step-by-step walkthroughs, and quizzes, with topic mastery and streaks to show progress. Built into the Gauth app.

items.name: Motionflare
items.tagline: Turn your website into a stunning launch video in minutes
items.description: Motionflare turns your website into a ready-to-share marketing video and brand film in minutes. Paste a URL and it uses your real product screenshots, logo, colors, and copy to create branded motion graphics with music and optional narration. Or switch to Film mode to generate a live-action commercial. Refine the result by chat and export in up to 4K.

items.name: Modem
items.tagline: Find, fix, and follow up on every customer concern
items.description: Modem monitors your customer channels (support tickets, group chat, sales calls) and alerts you to problems within minutes. It can automatically open an issue, spin up a coding agent, or escalate to the right team. When the fix ships, it closes the loop with your customers. Never lose track of a request again.

items.name: Dog Translator SuperTranslator
items.tagline: Dogs talking in English (real)
items.description: What if your dog could tell you what they're feeling? SuperTranslator uses AI to read your dog's body language, vocalizations and interactions with their surroundings, and turns those signals into plain English. Instead of random phrases from barks, it looks at several behavioral cues at once to help you understand what your dog might be communicating. According to our benchmarks, this is the most accurate dog translation in history.

items.name: Polylane Swarms
items.tagline: A team of AI agents on your roughest production incidents
items.description: Put a swarm of agents on your massive production incidents. Agents investigate possible causes in parallel, share evidence and check each other's findings. You get one answer with the root cause, the evidence and a proposed fix.

items.name: Chat with Work
items.tagline: AI bots in Europe. They work. You decide.
items.description: Create a bot with a single sentence. It works for you. Create as many as you need. They start by themselves and work across 1,920+ integrations with your laptop closed. When there's a decision to take, they ask you. Every question and approval from all your bots lands in one place. You just decide. Claude Duet: US only. ChatGPT's dots: not on Pro or Plus in Europe. Gemini's Tasks: not in Europe. Not us. Chat with Work's bots run in the EU, on every plan. 300 trial credits, no card.

items.name: Inkling 2 Mini
items.tagline: 26B looped model for coding on your laptop
items.description: Inkling 2 Mini is Thinking Machines' 26.4B open-weight model built for local agentic work. Its middle transformer layers run three times per token, adding reasoning depth without extra weights. It runs on 32GB Macs through Ollama.

items.name: Hydrilla
items.tagline: Generate production-ready 3D assets with AI
items.description: Hydrilla AI generates high-quality 3D assets from simple prompts. Designed for game developers, animation studios, and XR creators, it helps teams create production-ready models in minutes instead of days. Build faster pipelines for games, films, and immersive worlds.

items.name: Journalistic Tech
items.tagline: Async interviews that get you published on HackerNoon
items.description: Tell us what you do or what just happened. We match you to one of 273 technology interviews. Answer ~13 questions by voice or text, on your own time. Your answers become a bylined draft, an editor reviews and polishes it, then it publishes on HackerNoon and gets distributed around the web.

items.name: Tesla Self-Driving V15
items.tagline: Upgrading every part of the end-to-end driving network
items.description: What's new in FSD V15: • 25x better handling of safety-critical cases • Tesla Reality View: a live generative view from a virtual camera above your car, so you see and control what FSD plans • Fullscreen, map, split or quiet mode • Nav turns in the visualization; quieter turn signals • Trip start/end routing learned from fleet route preferences • Better detection of signs, animals, debris, potholes and standing water; smoother speed in school zones and bad weather

items.name: LeanTake
items.tagline: 4.1 MB native Mac screen recorder — zero export wait
items.description: Pure Swift + ScreenCaptureKit screen recorder for macOS 15+ (Apple Silicon). Real-time hardware encoding writes finishedmov videos the second you hit Stop. Includes a 12-color live pen, region magnifier, 9 3D cat paw cursors, and a window-excluded stealth teleprompter. Free forever (no watermark, no login); optional Pro $14.99 one-time.

items.name: Plango
items.tagline: Plango lets your AI agents work all night - safely
items.description: AI is wreaking havoc in cybersecurity. You need a command center to protect your device and AI-agent setup. There are two major risks today: 1. External AI attackers finding exploits 2. Internal AI taking unsafe actions Plango researches and patches vulnerabilities while running entirely on-device. It finds where you're vulnerable and shows how to fix it. (example: you may be vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks due to SSL certs compromised in October. Plango shows if you have them!)

items.name: Strict
items.tagline: Run GitHub Actions on any spare Mac or Linux machine
items.description: Turn spare Macs and Linux boxes into a self-healing, auto load-balancing GitHub Actions fleet at $0/min compute. Includes a native macOS Liquid Glass app, 7-tier disk cleanup, preflight doctor, and Tailscale-native setup—zero account required.

items.name: naturefunding.org
items.tagline: Grants for nature projects, checked against funder pages
items.description: A free directory of 1,000+ grants for nature restoration and conservation: forests, coasts, wetlands, wildlife and more. Every deadline, amount and eligibility rule links to the funder's own page, with its exact words and the date we checked it. Filter by place, deadline, who can apply and how to apply (directly, through a partner, or invitation only). No paid listings, no sign-up. Data is open (CC BY 4.0) as JSON, CSV and an Atom feed.

items.name: Omi Work
items.tagline: Omi can build anything. Now it finds your next 100 customers
items.description: Omi can build anything. Omi Work is an AI workspace for the hardest, longest jobs. Give it a goal: it shows the plan first, splits big work across sub-agents, searches the web, uses the apps you connect, keeps going after you close the tab, and hands back documents, sheets with formulas and slide decks. Ready-made teammates, scheduled tasks and voice mode. Teams get roles, SSO and an audit log. Free to start, no card.

items.name: Othor AI
items.tagline: Your Head of Intelligence. Know what your numbers are hiding
items.description: Othor AI is a new species of business intelligence, built on the tradecraft of intelligence agencies and a century of signal analysis. Automated statistical intelligence for business leaders: more signal, faster decisions, with the smallest possible AI bill and the least human effort. AI drafts the words; code computes every number, and any night can be replayed byte for byte. Open source (Apache-2.0); hosted or on your servers.

items.name: freddy
items.tagline: Private health data server: talk to your health with any AI
items.description: freddy is your health data server. Connect your wearables, rings, glucose monitors, training apps, Apple Health and Health Connect once, and add your lab results. freddy keeps every value as the source sends it. Use it with any AI, export it, or build on it.

items.name: Replit Missions
items.tagline: Set a budget, coordinate teams of AI agents,
items.description: Turn ambitious goals into outcomes with Replit Missions. Set a budget, coordinate teams of AI agents, and review progress against clear success criteria.

items.name: Ashwa
items.tagline: Your AI companion that never forgets what you say
items.description: Come back after 100 days, and Ashwa can still recall relevant details from your past conversations and diary entries. Pick up where you left off without repeating your story. Talk through your day, reflect in a private daily journal, and get responses shaped by the emotional context you've shared
